angle: Empowering HDB upgraders/first-time buyers to make financially sound private property decisions through detailed comparisons and personalized advice.
body_text:
Can you buy a private property with a combined income of $10K? HDB upgraders or first time buyer please watch this!

Ready to make the jump from HDB to private property but not sure which option fits your budget? 🤔

🏠 5-room resale flat – Great for space and familiar comfort.
🏙️ Executive Condo (EC) – Condo lifestyle at a lower price, but requires patience.
🏡 Private condo – Flexibility and freedom, but with higher upfront costs.

Let us show you a fair comparison, all the pros and cons of above options. We believe you need to be clear on what you are getting on.
Which one works best for your goals — space, lifestyle, or flexibility? 💭
Watch Part 1 to see how each option stacks up, and stay tuned for Part 2 where we’ll show you how to upgrade smartly without overstretching your finances! 💡

💬 **Got questions? Drop a comment** or DM us “PANNA” for personalized advice on planning your upgrade. 📩

headline: DO NOT UPGRADE till YOU ARE SURE!
transcript_text: 10k income? Can buy private property? Panda, I've got this couple earning a combined income of 10k a month. They're staying in a 4-room HDB in Tampines and can't decide should they go for a 5-room resale, an ECE or a private condo. Let's analyse for them. Now, getting a 5-room HDB means you get a bigger space, plus it's more affordable and the monthly instalment is lower. Also, HDBs tend to be in matured aspects, meaning there'll be schools, MRT stations and more amenities nearby. Exactly. Then there's the EC option, kind of like the middle ground. EC offers condo-style facilities and a lower entry price compared to private condos. They can choose to sell their current flat first or continue staying it till their EC is ready with no ABSD. But of course, EC and private condos, the unit size is usually smaller than a 5-room HDB. So how about we look at their numbers so we know what works for them? Follow us for part 2 where we deep dive into their numbers. And if you can't wait for part 2 and want your personalised numbers immediately, comment PAN UP and we will contact you.
